name: Silent Earwig 98
author: Codewithvinay
description: Gradient red text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: It has no :focus rule in its CSS; focusing the text input shows only the browser default.
html: <input type="text" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Type your text" name="text" class="input">
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Silent Earwig 98</title>
<style>
/* Silent Earwig 98 by Codewithvinay — https://uiverse.io/Codewithvinay/silent-earwig-98 */
.input {

  background: -webkit-linear-gradient(to right, #f7797d, #FBD786, #C6FFDD);

  background: linear-gradient(to right, #f7797d, #FBD786, #C6FFDD);

  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  border-radius: 89% 29% 90% 23% / 0% 100% 0% 100%;
  border-color: transparent;
  width: 200px;
  height: 50px;
  padding: 20px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: inherit;
  box-shadow: 23px 23px 46px #bebebe,
             -23px -23px 46px #ffffff;
}

.input::placeholder {
  color: white;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="text" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Type your text" name="text" class="input">

</body>
</html>
